response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software craftsmanship and versatile technical skills, he falls critically short on the primary technical requirement: only ~6 months of C++ experience versus 8 years required. His career has focused on web and application development (TypeScript, Node.js, D Lang), not systems-level programming or infrastructure/compute platform engineering. Although he has relevant experience with microservices, Kubernetes, and AWS CDK, the foundational C++ and compute platform expertise needed for a mid-senior technical lead role is significantly lacking.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, and testing-driven development demonstrated across multiple roles
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing ability through workshops, open-source projects, and creating educational content
Versatile technical foundation with experience across web, mobile, embedded systems, and some infrastructure work (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK)
concerns: Critical gap in C++ programming experience (~6 months actual vs. 8 years required) - does not meet minimum qualification
Career trajectory is primarily application/web development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems-level or compute platform engineering
Limited formal technical leadership experience; most roles are senior developer positions without explicit team leadership or large-scale infrastructure ownership
